summary: US forces struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island while Iran conducted drone attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait. Iraqi forces moved against IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah in Jurf al-Sakhar. Israeli artillery and airstrikes intensified across southern Lebanon with 99 alerts recorded.
key_points: US fighter jets struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island in a self-defense operation per CENTCOM. (Source: @yediotnews25/138069)
Iran attacked Bahrain twice and Kuwait once in the past 24 hours according to a SITREP. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10209)
An Iranian drone attack caused two bright fires in northern Kuwait; Kuwaiti air defenses engaged UAVs. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10203, @shin_persian/12508)
Iraqi PM Al-Zaidi ordered armed forces into Jurf al-Sakhar with a deadline for IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah to withdraw. (Source: @shin_persian/12502)
Israeli airstrikes hit Wadi al-Saluqi, Al-Mansouri, and Hula; artillery shelled nine locations across southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53675)
IDF thwarted a Kalashnikov rifle smuggling attempt from Egypt via balloons at Nitzana crossing. (Source: @manniefabian/59541)
IDF Chief Halevi insists US coordination is a prerequisite for any strike on Iran; alert directive remains unchanged. (Source: @yediotnews25/138067)
A missile launched from the 15 Khordad base in Baharestan, Isfahan; jet activity reported over Dezful, Khuzestan. (Source: @shin_persian/12504, @shin_persian/12505)

sections.executive_summary: US forces struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island while Iran conducted drone attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait. sections.threat_assessment: Direct kinetic exchanges between Iran and the US have commenced with the Qeshm Island strike and Iranian drone attacks on Gulf states, marking a significant escalation. Iraq's move against Kataib Hezbollah suggests Baghdad may be attempting to constrain Iranian proxy freedom of action under US pressure. Israel maintains high readiness for an Iran strike but is conditioned on US coordination, while simultaneously conducting intensive artillery and air operations in southern Lebanon. The multi-front pressure on Iranian assets — US strikes, Iraqi action, Israeli readiness — creates a volatile environment prone to miscalculation.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait activated air defenses against Iranian UAVs and documented fires, indicating a willingness to respond militarily. Iraq's deployment against Kataib Hezbollah represents a rare direct confrontation with an IRGC-backed group on Iraqi soil. Bahrain has not publicly detailed its response to the two reported attacks. Israel's political leadership maintains the Iran strike option while the military insists on US synchronization. Lebanese monitoring shows sustained high-intensity Israeli firepower across the border region.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 15 Khordad base missile launch in Isfahan and jet activity over Dezful suggest Iranian air defense readiness and possible retaliatory posture. The GLF5 SIGINT flight over Palestine indicates persistent Israeli electronic surveillance. The balloon-borne Kalashnikov smuggling attempt reveals continued Egyptian border vulnerability to low-tech aerial delivery. The SITREP's precise Zulu timestamps for Iranian attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait imply reliable detection capabilities. The Abadan sign destruction hints at domestic Iranian unrest that could affect regime decision-making.
